description: List the professions that have a ranking of frontier AI models built from independent benchmark results (lawyer, accountant, developer, salesperson, translator, engineer…), each marked as a direct or an indirect evaluation, with the model that ranks first today. Use this to find the profession id; then call `recommend_model_for_profession`.

evaluation.description: Restrict to direct evaluations (a benchmark reproduces the job) or indirect ones (general tests only).

group.description: Restrict to one family: knowledge, business, creative, tech, technical or care.

locale.description: Language of the names. The benchmarks site publishes en and es; other locales fall back to English.

name: list_professions

not_measured.description: What no benchmark in the catalogue evaluates at all. Applies even when `unmeasured_tasks` is 0.

unmeasured_tasks.description: How many of its listed TASKS no benchmark measures yet. Zero is complete task coverage, not a complete measurement — `not_measured` is a different axis and applies anyway.

title: List the professions with an AI model ranking
